spans.s:
f. (-का)
The chord of an arc.
E.
ज्या the same, कन् added.

r. 9th cl. (जिनाति)
To decay, to be or become old.

f. (-ज्या)
1 A mother.
2 The earth.
3 A bowstring.
4 The chord of an arc.
E.
ज्या to become old, to decay, affixes अङ्, and टाप्.

m. (-षः)
Twang of a bow.
E.
ज्या, and घोष sound.

f. (-निः)
1 Old age, decay, infirmity.
2 Abandoning, quitting, leaving.
3 A river, a stream.
E.
ज्या to decay, &c. Uṇādi aff. नि.

mfn. (-यान्-यसी-यः)
1 Very old.
2 Very excellent, best.
3 Elder, elder born.
4 In law, one independent and answerable for his own conduct.
E.
ज्या to be old, इयसुन् affix.
